Firing

The hold is where crystal growth happens. Drop it 80 °C and the same glaze frosts over; raise it and you get gloss.

IIIEvidence
—Method

Recipes are reduced to oxide moles and a unity formula; multivalent cations are speciated against an atmosphere ladder; each candidate phase gets a saturation ratio, a liquidus depression and a time–temperature–transformation curve; the kiln schedule is integrated against those curves; crystals and dopants feed a Fresnel / ligand-field colour model. Structures and habits are real crystallography. The kinetic constants are calibrated, not first-principles: treat absolute times as ±half a decade, and read the ranking, the mechanisms and the levers as the output.
